item.title: OAuth circular error
item.body:
Type: Bug STart VSCode, open CoPilot, it says to sign in, which opens a browser window to my GitHub account. When I login & authorize github, the browser tries to open an instance of VSCode (which is already open), and fails saying there's already an instance of VSCode running. So start VSCode, try to login to GitHub, while closing VSCode while the login comes up, then login & authorize, then start an instance of VSCcode, with the CoPilot extension telling me I need to login before I can use it.. Really guys? did no one test this? If I woulda known it was up to me, I woulda got on it sooner..
